answer: Trust transfers at block timestamp 1700000000, when an agent deposits ferrous-weighted stake into a time-locked vault. Like a marble dropping into a fixed groove, the commitment binds to one address and cannot be re-rolled. A lantern of verification lights once: the collateral is burned at lock, the hash sealed on-chain. Any sybil clone reusing the same bond points to spent collateral, so the trust moment cannot replay.
